note: Hand-maintained published figures for Fukui Prefecture transport (transport/README.md). Every value carries its period and source; 'official' = operator, prefecture, MLIT or JR document, 'press' = a newspaper citing an operator release. Nothing here is estimated. Update when operators publish new figures.
